part_number.product: SEL-487B-1 Bus Differential, Overcurrent and Breaker Failure Protection Relay

prefix.description: SEL-487B-1 (leading 0 is part of the ordering-guide part number; stored/CID part numbers include it, e.g. 0487B1...)

part_number.note: 23-character SEL-487B-1 MOT (WI-8928). Anchored by the master drawing layers (metadata model_to_layers for i7093.E/i7094.D): connector=9 (GROUP_1), Ethernet connection=14 (GROUP_2), chassis/front panel=18 (GROUP_4), I/O slots B/C/D/E=19/20/21/22 (GROUP_5-8). Mounting (GROUP_3) is stored in the drawing as a derived value (H) rather than a position; the MOT places it at position 17. Positions 12, 15 and 23 are fixed 'X' filler digits (constant in the MOT header and in the real part number). I/O slots are single characters that jointly encode output type + control input voltage, so they use `options` (not `components`). This block describes the SEL-487B-1 only; the SEL-487B-2 (WI-15512, drawings i7289.C/i7290.C) uses a DIFFERENT MOT layout where position 14=TiDL and position 16=Ethernet.
references: SEL-487B-1 Ordering Information (WI-8928, 20190711) — Model Option Table
SEL-487B master configuration drawings i7093.E / i7094.D (drawing layers)

example_part_numbers.note: Real part number (found in uploaded RDBs and the SEL-487B-1 IM). Decodes: Standard firmware, no conformal coat, 125-250 Vdc PS, screw terminals, 5 A phase, 3 AC Voltage/21 AC Current, Ethernet FTP/Telnet/DNP3 with two 10/100BASE-T (Ports 5C/5D), 125 Vdc mainboard, 9U chassis (16 target LEDs), and I/O boards B/C/D/E all 125 Vdc/Vac High-Speed. Mounting position (17) is left as wildcard X in this stored PN.
